study type: Pilot cohort study for score development and validation
cohort: The study included forty neonates and young infants diagnosed with respiratory distress secondary to infectious causes.
finding: The Neonatal Clinical Risk Assessment Score (N-CRAS) strongly correlated with clinical severity and accurately identified all infants requiring intubation.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was not significantly associated with respiratory illness severity.
birth_weight: Birth weight category was included as a variable.
gest_age: Gestational age was included as a variable.
